note: Field Hidden defines three Field API widget plugins (all labelled 'Hidden field') that render core number/plain-text fields as input[type=hidden]: field_hidden_string_textfield (string), field_hidden_string_textarea (string_long), field_hidden_number (integer/decimal/float). No config route, no settings form, no config schema, no permissions, no Drush. Persistent state is only the chosen widget `type` on a field component inside an entity_form_display config entity (e.g. core.entity_form_display.node.article.default -> content.<field>.type). It is NOT the same as choosing '- Hidden -', which drops the field from the form. Medium cases read back which widget id a known field uses; hard cases switch a field's form-display widget to the appropriate field_hidden widget, verified against the live entity_form_display. All fixture fields are namespaced field_fh_*.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module field_hidden, which field widget plugin ids does it provide and which core field types does each apply to?
evals.expected_output: Three 'Hidden field' widgets: field_hidden_string_textfield (string / Text plain), field_hidden_string_textarea (string_long / Text plain long), and field_hidden_number (integer, decimal, float).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal Manage form display page, what is the difference between choosing field_hidden's 'Hidden field' widget and choosing the '- Hidden -' region for a field?
evals.expected_output: '- Hidden -' removes the field from the form entirely (no input rendered, value not submitted, default not saved). field_hidden's 'Hidden field' widget keeps the field in the form as an <input type=hidden>, so its (default/JS-set) value is still submitted and saved.

evals.prompt: I enabled field_hidden but there's no settings page. How do I make a text field render as a hidden input, and where is that choice stored in config?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. On the bundle's Manage form display page pick the 'Hidden field' widget for the field. It is stored as the component type in core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.type (e.g. field_hidden_string_textfield).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a text field named field_fh_secret whose form widget is set by the field_hidden module. Inspect the live default form display for Article and name the exact widget plugin id used for field_fh_secret.
evals.expected_output: field_fh_secret uses the widget field_hidden_string_textfield in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has an integer field field_fh_count configured with a field_hidden widget on its default form display. Inspect the running site and state which field_hidden widget plugin id it uses.
evals.expected_output: field_fh_count uses the widget field_hidden_number (the widget field_hidden provides for integer/decimal/float).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a text (string) field field_fh_token that currently uses the standard textfield widget. Using the field_hidden module, change the default form display so field_fh_token renders as a hidden input. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_fh_token component in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default to type field_hidden_string_textfield (via Manage form display 'Hidden field' widget, or by saving the form display component).

evals.prompt: The Article content type has an integer field field_fh_score using the standard number widget. Use field_hidden to make that field a hidden input on the default form display, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_fh_score component in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default to type field_hidden_number.
